overall_goal: Microwave the frozen banana and mash it

goals.description: Place the banana in a jug and start the microwave
goals.rationale: The person puts the frozen banana into a glass jug, places it in the microwave, and starts the heating process.

goals.description: Take the jug out of the microwave
goals.rationale: The person opens the microwave, retrieves the heated jug, and closes the door.

goals.description: Mash and stir the banana with a fork
goals.rationale: The person uses a fork to scrape, mash, and stir the heated banana inside the jug.
